unstuck_said.text: First contact as dhyabi2 issue #1 (github.com/ShinjukuStaition/shinjuku-shield#1): proposed a Nano feeless settle rail for agents that hold only a Nano account (no USDC float, no Solana wallet). Grounded in their self-custody + we-pay-the-fees model: a Nano send block is its own settlement (BLAKE2b hash, block_info verified, no gas/relayer), and their existing we-pay-the-seller-from-our-float covers the conversion. Addressed their we-pay-fees model directly (Nano has zero fees). Asked if the shielding model is Solana-specific by design or if a Nano fund-source PR is welcome. Public as open res
